mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5%) signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production indicates weakening supply chain activity and reduced corporate output, consistently generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without threshold requirements.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 900,000 units signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and elevated rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) indicate restrictive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 2.5, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Slow GDP growth (annualized GDPC1 growth < 1.0%) signals weak economic expansion that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year period.
